## QuantFunc MiniMax-H3

QuantFunc runs the H3 transformer and joint video/audio sampling. CLIPLoader (type minimax), the VAEs, conditioning, scheduler and sampler are stock ComfyUI.

- Transformer: `minimax_h3_fl2va_4step_quantfunc_int4_r128.safetensors`, from [QuantFunc on ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/QuantFunc/Minimax-H3-Quantfunc-4bit), in models/diffusion_models.
- Text encoder: `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors`. Video VAE: `minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors`. Audio VAE: `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors`, from [Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3).
- Saved canvas: 768x768, 124 frames.
- Saved sampling: 8 total steps, res_multistep / simple, denoise 1, attention sage.
- Saved seed: 42 (fixed).
- First/last frames: both inputs are enabled and use `minimax_h3_fl2va_beach_reference.png`. Either anchor is optional; with neither, this is text-to-video.

Single-stage sampling at the saved canvas size. Change the prompt, canvas and frame count in the H3 conditioning node.

【一、 AI 生成設定值 (MiniMax-H3 Generation Settings)】
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
● 生成模式：First-to-Last Frame (FL2V / 首尾幀生成)
● 鏡頭運動 (Camera Motion)：Zoom Out & Slow Pan Up (向後拉遠並緩緩上搖)

[First Frame Prompt (首幀提示詞)]
A cinematic close-up of Queen Cleopatra in ancient Alexandria. She wears an elaborate 
gold headdress encrusted with lapis lazuli and emeralds, draped in a regal turquoise 
and gold silk gown. Her expression is fierce, proud, and commanding. The background 
is a sunlit marble palace interior with soft golden hour light filtering through tall 
columns. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, historical drama aesthetic.

[Last Frame Prompt (尾幀提示詞)]
A cinematic medium shot of Queen Cleopatra standing proudly on the high balcony of her 
palace at twilight. Her gold headdress remains majestic, but her posture shifts to a 
visionary gaze looking out over the illuminated city of Alexandria and the Nile river 
under a starry night sky. Dramatic lighting, wind gently blowing her silk gown, epic 
and emotional cinematic finish, 8k.

[Motion / Image-to-Video Prompt (動態引導提示詞)]
Smooth transition from a close-up portrait to a wider balcony view. Cleopatra slowly 
turns her head with a powerful, confident gaze, her lips curving into a subtle, enigmatic 
smile. The camera gently pulls back and pans upward. The silk garments and gold ornaments 
catch the shifting light from golden hour to twilight. Fluid motion, highly detailed 
textures, no morphing artifacts.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

【二、 影音與旁白分鏡腳本 (Audio-Visual Storyboard & Voiceover)】
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
時間   | 畫面與運鏡 (Visual & Motion)      | 音樂與音效 (BGM & SFX)    | 中文旁白 (Voiceover)
-------|----------------------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------------
00-02s | 【首幀特寫】                      | 古埃及奈伊笛 (Ney Flute)   | 尼羅河的風，吹過三千年的風沙……
       | 金色陽光灑在青金石頭飾上，埃及豔  | 單音開場，伴隨細微風鈴與  | 
       | 後眼神威嚴且自信。                | 沙漠風吹聲。              | 
-------|----------------------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------------
00-05s | 【動態過渡】                      | 弦樂器（大提琴與小提琴）  | 帝國的榮耀，終將在此刻定格。
       | 鏡頭緩緩向後拉開，光影從黃昏暖金  | 逐漸切入，旋律氣勢漸強。  | 
       | 漸變為晚霞藍紫。豔後微微一笑。    |                           | 
-------|----------------------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------------
00-08s | 【高潮鏡頭】                      | 定音鼓與手鼓沉穩加入，    | 我是這片大地永遠的女王——
       | 微風吹拂絲綢與飾品，畫面呈現高處  | 將文明史詩感推至最高潮。  | 埃及，盡在我的掌握之中。
       | 俯瞰亞歷山大港的全景趨勢。        |                           | 
-------|----------------------------------|---------------------------|---------------------------------
00-10s | 【尾幀定格】                      | 宏大管弦樂瞬間收尾，留下一| （無旁白，維持震撼氣氛）
       | 夜幕降臨，亞歷山大港燈火通明，豔  | 絲悠長的空靈迴響。        | 
       | 後傲立於高台俯瞰帝國。            |                           | 
================================================================================
